_doc: Motedis Aluprofil 40x80L I-Typ Nut 8: a 40 mm aluminium profile, light, made to match item's Line 8 (profile-4080-item-8l). Outer size, opening, slot depth, bore and the section figures are from Motedis' own data picture; what it does not print (the lip, the cavity's width, the corner radius, the hollows) is item's figure or scaled off item's drawing, and says so. It is described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment (Motedis' Iy). The drawn outline leaves out the hollow behind each lip of the light groove, the rounded mouths and the rounds in the hollows, so it comes out heavier than Motedis' figures.
